basis: The Nova Scotia boil water advisory register is published on Open Data Nova Scotia (Socrata dataset 7t68-9xmm) under the Open Government Licence - Nova Scotia v1.1, linked from the dataset's own page and read at discovery (2026-10-27, via the extraction backend because novascotia.ca direct fetch times out from the coordinator; recorded in the candidate record's license_evidence with the quoted clauses). OGL-NS v1.1 grants a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence to copy, modify, publish, translate, adapt, distribute and otherwise use the information for any lawful purpose, including commercially. Class A (attribution-only open licence permitting redistribution and derivatives), so the standing defaults apply: our code and documentation are MIT, our rights in the derived compilation are dedicated CC0-1.0, and the source's own terms are preserved, never relicensed.

compilation.scope: Our contribution - the eligibility frame (parseable issue date, issue date at or before the vintage minus 30 days), the derived lift-within-30-days label, the as-of site/county history feature derivations, the reason-category normalisation, the disjoint issue-year partition, and the packaging - is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The dedication covers only our contribution: the underlying boil water advisory register keeps its own designation and remains subject to the Open Government Licence - Nova Scotia v1.1, whose attribution condition carries through to every copy of the derived data. Nothing here relicenses the source or presents CC0 as the source's terms.
